capabilities

Digital Command, llc

  • Name: Digital Command, LLC
  • Founded: October 20, 2020
  • Incorporated in: North Carolina
  • Type: Limited Liability Company (LLC)
  • Certifications: Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB)

Overview

Digital Command, LLC specializes in empowering government agencies and organizations to thrive in the digital-first economy. As a Veteran-Owned Small Business, we provide expertise in digital skills training, leadership development, and workforce transformation, ensuring measurable success in navigating the rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Our solutions are designed to address the unique challenges of government teams, focusing on AI and data literacy, change management, and operational optimization. With proven methodologies like “The Five Tangles” and actionable strategies from tools such as The AI Lead: Overcoming Data Drag, Digital Command empowers leaders to break barriers and achieve operational excellence.

Core Competencies

  • Digital Skills Training
  • Leadership Development
  • Workforce Transformation
  • AI and Data Literacy Programs
  • Tailored Curriculum Development
  • Workforce Development for Future
  • AI Leadership Coaching
  • Strategic Playbooks
  • Digital Equity Initiatives

Certifications and Compliance

  • Certifications: Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB)
  • Compliance: Adherence to industry standards for workforce transformation and digital literacy
  • NAICS Codes:
  • 611430: Professional and Management Development Training
  • 611420: Computer Training
  • 541611: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services

Key Differentiators

Action-Oriented
  • Our “Digital First, Job Second” core philosophy ensures immediate, measurable impact. By prioritizing digital fluency, we empower teams to tackle challenges head-on and adapt seamlessly to a technology-driven world.
AI and Big Data Expertise

  • Combining cutting-edge knowledge in AI and data integration, we deliver solutions that eliminate inefficiencies and unlock the full potential of advanced technologies. From real-time analytics to ethical AI adoption, our expertise ensures optimized decision-making and operational excellence.

Tailored Specifically for the Digtial Age

  • Through our academy, we offer tailored learning paths and practical training, empowering individuals and organizations with skills in AI, data literacy, and leadership. These programs ensure teams are equipped with the tools to thrive in the evolving digital workplace.

Proven Frameworks

  • Digital Command leverages its expertise in overcoming transformation barriers with methodologies like The Five Tangles, addressing resistance to change, and fostering innovation in organizations of all sizes.

Proven Blueprint for Transformation

  • Our foundational content based on the best-selling and awards winning book, The AI Lead: Overcoming Data Drag, provides leaders with actionable insights to address organizational bottlenecks, optimize workflows, and lead with precision in the AI age. It serves as both a guide and inspiration for leveraging AI for strategic success.

New Foundations for the Digital Age

  1. We build resilient, digitally fluent teams by emphasizing accessibility, equity, and innovation. Our commitment to foundational digital skills bridges the gap between technical expertise and leadership, creating a sustainable future for professionals and organizations alike.

Lets Talk

Need Help?

Tell us a bit about your needs, and we’ll connect you with the right solutions to help you take command.

+1 980.202.2906

Testimonials

"Before discovering Digital Command, I felt completely overwhelmed by the rapid pace of change in the digital workplace. I didn’t think someone without a technical background like mine could thrive in such a demanding environment. The training programs opened my eyes to practical, actionable skills I could apply immediately. Today, I’m leading projects with confidence and helping my team embrace digital transformation." Sarah MProject Manager "As someone mid-career, I thought I had all the tools I needed—until I realized I was falling behind. Digital Command’s tailored curriculum not only taught me AI basics but also how to integrate these tools into my role. The clarity and simplicity of the program changed my career trajectory. I finally feel relevant and empowered in the workplace again." Jason T.Junior Analyst "I had no idea where to begin with digital skills—it all felt so complicated. Digital Command showed me that you don’t need to be a tech expert to make a difference. With their step-by-step guidance and approachable learning paths, I now feel confident using AI and data-driven insights to solve real problems in my organization." Emily LOperations Specialist find out more
